samples.summary: `NotesView`'s `showAuthors` fallback is now dead, and the comment updated in this diff justifies it with a mount that does not exist. The revised doc comment says the stored-preference fallback is "kept for a mount that owns no view menu (the revision preview)", but `revision-preview.tsx` never renders `NotesView` — it calls `initializeNote()` from `@wafflebase/notes` directly (revision-preview.tsx:756-759). Grepping `NotesView` in packages/frontend/src shows exactly two render sites, `notes-detail.tsx:319` and the new `shared-notes-layout.tsx:116`, and both now pass `showAuthors` explicitly, so `storedShowAuthors` (notes-view.tsx:107) can never be reached. Cost is confined to the codebase: an unreachable branch plus a doc comment that points a future reader at the wrong consumer.

`notes-settings.ts`'s module docstring is left contradicting the change: it states "The owner editor (NotesDetail) reads them on open and writes them on change; the read-only shared viewer does not use them" (notes-settings.ts:6-7), while this change makes `SharedNotesLayout` read all three keys (shared-notes-layout.tsx:8-10, 50-53). The read/never-write split is the interesting new invariant of this module's consumers and the one place a reader would look for it now records the opposite.

The view-mode preference plumbing is now duplicated rather than shared. `SharedNotesLayout` re-implements `NotesLayout`'s `viewMode`/`keymap`/`showAuthors` state seeding plus the mobile demotion rule verbatim (`isMobile && viewMode === "both" ? "edit" : viewMode`, shared-notes-layout.tsx:57-58 vs notes-detail.tsx:119-120), and the diff's own comment change in `notes-toolbar.tsx:402-404` now has to name both routes to describe one rule. The repo's stated expectation is reuse, and the natural shape here is one hook (e.g. `useNoteViewPreferences({ persist })`) that both routes call — there is none (no hook exists; `readViewMode`/`readKeymap`/`readShowAuthors` have only these three call sites). Behaviour is identical today, so the cost is divergence risk on the exact rule the design doc says the two entry paths "finally agree" on.

The chunk-count budget is raised by 3 with no measurement at all, and the new `maxChunkCountNotesShareToolbarReason` says so in its own words ("NOT measured locally — the number is headroom for a known hoist, and CI's chunk gate is the measurement"). Every sibling reason key in this file states a measured before/after (223, 219, 218->213). Bumping the gate to 231 on an estimate inverts the convention: the gate stops being a check on this change and becomes an assertion the change makes about itself. Cost is internal (a weaker bundle gate), not user-visible.

The `@wafflebase/notes` divider change (7px -> 25px band, `box-sizing`, and the `track = rect.width - divider.offsetWidth` drag math) is engine-wide scope reached from a share-link-parity issue: it changes the desktop workspace note editor's split layout for every user, not just the surface #1044 is about. The `touch-action: none` half is clearly in scope (it is what made touch resize impossible); the width/geometry rework is a separate UX change riding along, and notes.md justifies it only as "it helps both". Worth splitting or at least calling out as an intentional visual change; no functional cost claimed here.

notes.md now claims the share-link upload "path behaves as it does for a member", but the member path in `notes-detail.tsx:208-231` wraps `uploadImageFile` in try/catch, toasts the failure and returns `null` so the engine drops its placeholder, whereas `SharedNotesLayout` hands the raw `shareTokenImageUploader(token)` (which rejects) straight to `NotesView`. The parity the design doc records is therefore only the happy path. (It does mirror `SharedDocsLayout:331-334`, so it is a documented-claim mismatch rather than a novel pattern; failure-handling detail itself belongs to the correctness lens.)
